description: This file defines the class AzureOpenAIResponsesAPIConfig which customizes and extends behavior for interacting with Azure OpenAI's responses API. It includes methods for URL construction, environment validation, response handling, and request transformations specific to Azure's API endpoints and requirements.

classes.name: AzureOpenAIResponsesAPIConfig
classes.description: A configuration subclass for handling Azure-specific responses API interactions, including URL scaffolding, environment validation, response filtering, and request preparation tailored for Azure's API structure.

methods.description: Validates Azure environment headers and parameters.

methods.description: Removes specific substrings from a model name to get a clean model identifier.

methods.description: Validates and filters 'status' fields out of message inputs.

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_get_response_api_request( self, response_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, )

methods.name: Tuple[str,Dict] transform_list_input_items_request( self, response_id: str, api_base: str, litellm_params: GenericLiteLLMParams, headers: dict, after: Optional[str] = None, before: Optional[str] = None, include: Optional[List[str]] = None, limit: int = 20, order: Literal["asc", "desc"] = "desc", )
